text: Traditionally vinegar sets it, which makes it slightly sour and soft; the Philippine Carabao Center teaches rennet instead, for a firmer, milder cheese.

links.name: Philippine Carabao Center iASK B-02-2017: Proper heat treatment yields more cheese with firmer texture (Abella, Saturno, Baltazar)

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Calf or carabao rennet (PCC/Laguna), or vinegar or citrus juice (Bulacan, Cavite).
In 1–2 in cubes, rested 10 min, then cut smaller and rested 15 min.
400 g salt in 5 L boiled, cooled (35–40 °C) water added to the cut curd for 20 min, or 1–4 tsp salt in the milk at home.
